issues.description: The problem statement and the template define Course.ratings as an array of Int, but the solution defines ratings as [Double] and updates the initializer/signature accordingly. This creates a cross-artifact type mismatch for the ratings property and constructor parameter and leads to further type inconsistencies in methods that sum and append ratings. Students will be confused which element type to use (Int vs Double) and may face compile errors if following the solution's types as-is.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ratings type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution to use ratings: [Int] (and initializer parameter ratings: [Int]) so it matches the problem statement and template; update getAverageRating() to sum Int values and return Double as Double(sum)/Double(count). Alternatively, if you intend ratings to be Double, update the problem statement and template to specify ratings as [Double] and adjust addRating and averaging logic accordingly.
